idea.name: Volume Compass: long coins whose volume-weighted drift is up, short those drifting down (2x, probation)
idea.blurb: 22 perps · daily: each coin's last 7/14/28 days of returns, weighted by the dollars traded each day - positive drift = long leg, negative = short leg, 0.5x each side · market-neutral-ish · 2x
idea.source: Huang, Sangiorgi & Urquhart, 'Cryptocurrency Volume-Weighted Time Series Momentum', SSRN 4825389 (May 2024, rev. Dec 2024)
idea.rule: Every day 00:00 UTC: for each coin, the volume-weighted mean daily return over 7, 14 and 28 days; signal = average sign; long the positive coins (weights by signal, 0.5x), short the negative ones (0.5x); hold a day; whole book 2x.

backtest.period: Apr 2023 - Oct 2026 daily (dollar-volume history starts 2023), 22 Hyperliquid perps, rule fixed before the first run, net of 4.5 bp taker + 1 bp latency + spread and funding
backtest.risk_dial: 1x 11.5%/yr DD 38% · 1.5x 15.0%/yr DD 52% · 2x 16.8%/yr DD 64% (live, top of the growth curve) · 2.5x 16.7%/yr DD 73% · 3x 14.8%/yr DD 80%
backtest.caveat: PROBATION: the volume weighting clearly matters (plain TSMOM on the same book loses, Sharpe -0.30; random direction books beat it 0.8% of the time), but the edge is a ONE-DAY effect that costs eat: gross Sharpe 1.15 becomes 0.56 net, x3 costs or entering a day late turn it negative, weekly rebalancing kills it, and a walk-forward lookback choice lost money out of sample (-0.36). Most of the profit came in 2023-24; 2025 lost half the book at 2x. 2x means a 64% backtest drawdown; kill at 70%.

ideas.name: Intraday noise-area momentum on 4h bars (BTC+ETH)
ideas.source: Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon, 'Beat the Market: An Effective Intraday Momentum Strategy for SPY', SSRN 4824172 (2024)
ideas.rule: UTC day session; long/short outside the 14-day noise band at each 4h close, flat at day end, 2% daily vol target.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: gross Sharpe 1.13 but -0.07 net of taker costs Jul 2024-Oct 2026 (L7 0.14, L28 -0.38; VWAP stop no better).

ideas.name: Last-4h intraday momentum (00-20 UTC sign -> 20-24 UTC)
ideas.source: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou, 'Market intraday momentum', JFE 2018; Shen, Urquhart & Wang, 'Bitcoin intraday time series momentum', Financial Review 2022
ideas.rule: Trade the 20:00-24:00 UTC bar in the direction of the 00-20 UTC return, BTC/ETH/SOL; variant only on high-move days.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: net Sharpe -3.06 (high-move days -1.79) Jul 2024-Oct 2026; gross negative for all three coins - the last bar reverses.

ideas.name: Conditional beta: high-beta coins in up markets, low-beta in down markets
ideas.source: Pettengill, Sundaram & Mathur, 'The conditional relation between beta and returns', JFQA 30(1) 1995
ideas.rule: Sundays: 90d beta to the EW basket x sign of the basket's 28d return; long top 4, short bottom 4.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: net Sharpe 0.45 (CI -0.32..1.19) 2020-2026 but -0.43 over the last 2 years (2024 -17%, 2025 -17%).

ideas.name: Low-kurtosis long/short (56-day excess kurtosis, weekly 4 v 4)
ideas.source: higher-moment screen (same family as the tested skewness/coskewness work)
ideas.rule: Sundays: long 4 lowest, short 4 highest 56d kurtosis.

ideas.name: Weekly Noise Band: BTC/ETH only when the week escapes its usual noise (2x, probation) - Strategy 37
ideas.source: Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon, 'Beat the Market: An Effective Intraday Momentum Strategy for S&P500 ETF (SPY)', SSRN 4824172 (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4824172); session stretched to a week
ideas.rule: Daily 00:00 UTC per coin (BTC, ETH): O = Monday close; band = 8-week mean |move from O| for that weekday; long above O(1+band), short below O(1-band), else flat; flat after Sun/Mon closes; size 0.5 x min(4, 2%/28d vol); 2x.
ideas.verdict: Probation (best of 7, none passed): net Sharpe 0.37 (CI -0.47..1.15), 5.7%/yr DD 31% at 1x (7.0%/yr DD 57% at live 2x) Oct 2020-Oct 2026, walk-forward 0.43, placebo p=0.076, x3 costs -0.01; beta -0.04 and |corr| <= 0.28 with every live book.

ideas.name: Gold-Bitcoin Duel: each week the stronger of Bitcoin and gold, if it is rising (3x, probation) - Strategy 39
ideas.rule: Every Wednesday close, per lookback 4/8/12 weeks: BTC if its return beats gold's and is > 0, gold (PAXG perp) if gold's beats BTC's and is > 0, else cash; average the 3 sleeves; hold a week; 3x.
ideas.verdict: Source rule unchanged, Jan 2025-Oct 2026 net: Sharpe 0.95 (CI -0.34..2.39), 25%/yr DD 21% at 1x, 55%/yr DD 57% at 3x (live), placebo p=0.004, walk-forward 0.73, beats BTC (-0.26) and gold (0.64); probation because only 21 months of daily gold and the 2021-26 monthly-average check is weak (0.33).

ideas.name: Gold vs Bitcoin dual momentum, long-sample monthly-average check (2021-2026)
ideas.rule: Monthly: 1/2/3-month composite on monthly average prices, signal lagged one month.
ideas.verdict: Sharpe 0.33, 5.8%/yr, DD 56% vs BTC 0.54 and gold 1.16 (Jan 2021-Aug 2026): the crude long-sample proxy does not beat holding either asset; kept as a caveat on Strategy 39.

ideas.name: Internal Bar Strength (IBS) mean reversion, daily (BTC+ETH and 22 coins)
ideas.source: Pagonidis, 'The IBS Effect: Mean Reversion in Equity ETFs' (NAAIM 2013)
ideas.rule: Long when yesterday's (C-L)/(H-L) < 0.2, short when > 0.8, else flat; hold one day.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: net Sharpe -0.41 on BTC+ETH (gross -0.08), -0.64 on 22 coins (gross -0.20); crypto daily bars do not revert like equity ETFs.

ideas.name: Volume-weighted TSMOM, weekly rebalance (candidate B)
ideas.rule: Same volume-weighted 7/14/28-day TSMOM winner-minus-loser book, rebalanced Mondays only.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: net Sharpe -0.19 (gross 0.01) - the volume-weighted edge exists only at the one-day horizon.

ideas.name: Volume Compass: volume-weighted time-series momentum, long/short (2x, probation) - Strategy 40
ideas.source: Huang, Sangiorgi & Urquhart, 'Cryptocurrency Volume-Weighted Time Series Momentum', SSRN 4825389 (2024) https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4825389
ideas.rule: Daily 00:00 UTC: per coin the dollar-volume-weighted mean daily return over 7/14/28 days; signal = average sign; long positive coins (0.5x, weights by signal), short negative coins (0.5x); hold a day; whole book 2x.
ideas.verdict: Probation: real signal (placebo p 0.008; beats plain TSMOM by 1.1 Sharpe) but thin after costs - net Sharpe 0.56 (CI -0.59..1.69), 11.5%/yr at 1x, walk-forward -0.36, negative at x3 costs or 1 day late; live 2x = 16.8%/yr with a 64% drawdown, kill at 70%.
